comparisons.peer_topic: Global manufacturing footprint and subcontractor use
comparisons.peer_summary: Products are manufactured in own facilities across seven countries and utilize subcontractors for certain processes.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron disclose the strategic importance and operational reality of their own internal manufacturing capabilities for producing semiconductor products. Intel emphasizes its unique global position possessing the specific process technology and facilities for leading-edge logic chips, while Micron highlights its ownership of manufacturing facilities across seven countries to produce memory products, noting that this manufacturing is capital-intensive. Both disclosures center on the company's direct ownership and operation of fabrication infrastructure as a core component of their business model.

sentences.text: We are one of only a few companies in the world with the process technology and manufacturing facilities to produce leading-edge semiconductor logic chips.

We manufacture our products within our own facilities located in Taiwan, Singapore, Japan, the United States, Malaysia, China, and India and also utilize subcontractors to perform certain manufacturing processes.
Semiconductor manufacturing is capital intensive, requiring large investments in sophisticated facilities and equipment.

comparisons.peer_topic: Fabless manufacturing strategy and cost benefits
comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA utilizes a fabless and contracting manufacturing strategy, employing partners for wafer fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging to avoid significant costs and risks associated with owning manufacturing operations. This approach allows the company to focus resources on product design, quality assurance, marketing, and customer support.
comparisons.comparison: This comparison highlights the divergence in manufacturing business models between Intel and NVIDIA. Intel asserts that it is one of very few companies globally with the process technology and facilities to produce leading-edge semiconductor logic chips, indicating an Integrated Device Manufacturer (IDM) or foundry model with significant internal capital assets. In contrast, NVIDIA explicitly states it utilizes a fabless strategy, employing partners for all manufacturing phases including wafer fabrication to avoid the significant costs and risks associated with owning such operations.

sentences.text: We are one of only a few companies in the world with the process technology and manufacturing facilities to produce leading-edge semiconductor logic chips.

We utilize a fabless and contracting manufacturing strategy, whereby we employ and partner with key suppliers for all phases of the manufacturing process, including wafer fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging.
Additionally, we can avoid many of the significant costs and risks associated with owning and operating manufacturing operations.
